item: Data: tables, migrations, legacy carry and mirror
note: Two additive migrations. Part 2: applied on a restored copy of the lane DB, a second deploy changed nothing, no leave drift; legacy leave tables are empty in the lane DB, so 'identical' is weak; carry run twice in a rolled-back transaction copied nothing the second time (leave-flow-db test).

item: Rules and engine: balances, proration, carry-over, cover, overlap, routing, cancel, adjust with PIN
note: Part 2: 10 database-flow tests pass (ask, overlap, same key twice, double decide, idempotent approve, wrong PIN, cancel, carry-over once, adjust below zero, casual worker, legacy carry twice, audit chain). They found and fixed a real bug: the person lock used $queryRaw on a void column.

item: Endpoints (M1-M6, D1-D4, B1-B3, C1, S1-S2, N1) and rota/Today/On leave/Coming up hooks
note: Part 2: 127-check per-role HTTP proof, 0 failed (cross-site 404, forbidden writes 403, casual worker empty). Timesheets leaveDays and payroll unpaid-days hooks deliberately not built (decision 9).

item: Leave slip: LVE number, frozen snapshot, QR payload, A4 PDF, cancelled variant, documents registration function
note: Part 2: both PDFs (approved, cancelled with CANCELLED stamp and VOID mark) looked at by eye. Found and fixed: a waiter with no position showed 'HR' as the role line; floor roles now have words and the fallback is 'Staff'.

item: Capabilities, audit events, notifications, leave.requested/decided events
note: leave.balance_adjust (HR only): the HTTP proof shows 403 for every other role. Audit actions requested, approved, declined, cancelled and balance_adjusted seen in the log, chain verifies, no PIN in any entry. One gap: adjustBalance itself does not check the capability, only the route does.

note: Part 2: with Nyeri Town switched on, the old POST /hr/leave/request answered 409 LEAVE_IN_NEW_SYSTEM and the old leave tables were unchanged; switched off again afterwards. No hr-service test failed in the full suite.
